# E-commerce Push Notification Strategies
Push notifications are a powerful tool for e-commerce apps to engage users, drive sales, and enhance the overall shopping experience. By delivering timely and relevant messages directly to a user's device, businesses can encourage app usage, nurture leads, and provide critical updates throughout the customer journey.

## Common Notification Types and Their Purposes
Here are the most common types of push notifications used by e-commerce applications, along with their primary objectives:

-   **Welcome & Onboarding:**
    Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/hand-thumbs-up.svg
    Purpose: Greets new users, introduces app features, and often includes a special offer (e.g., first-purchase discount) to encourage initial engagement and conversion.

-   **Promotional & Sales Alerts:**
    Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tags.svg
    Purpose: Informs users about new arrivals, flash sales, discounts, seasonal promotions, or exclusive deals to generate immediate interest and drive purchases.

-   **Abandoned Cart Reminders:**
    Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cart-x.svg
    Purpose: Reminds users about items left in their shopping cart, often including a call to action or a small incentive (e.g., free shipping) to complete the purchase.

-   **Order Status Updates:**
    Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/truck.svg
    Purpose: Provides crucial updates on an order's journey, such as order confirmation, shipping notification with tracking details, and delivery confirmation, building trust and reducing customer anxiety.

-   **Back-in-Stock & Price Drop Alerts:**
    Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/bell.svg
    Purpose: Notifies users when a previously unavailable item they showed interest in is back in stock or when the price of a favorited item has dropped, prompting a potential purchase.

-   **Personalized Recommendations:**
    Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/star.svg
    Purpose: Suggests products based on a user's browsing history, past purchases, or wishlist, aiming to increase relevance and encourage additional purchases through tailored content.

-   **Review & Feedback Requests:**
    Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/chat-dots.svg
    Purpose: Asks users to review recently purchased products or provide feedback on their shopping experience, helping to build social proof and improve services.
